name: Koala Gifts
summary: Shopify app by ProfitKoala for free gifts with purchase, BOGO and buy-X-get-Y offers, gift pickers, product add-ons and add-to-cart upsell pop-ups, with plans set by the store's Shopify plan rather than by orders or revenue.
best_for: Shopify stores that want free gifts with purchase, BOGO and buy-X-get-Y offers, a gift picker, product add-ons and add-to-cart upsell pop-ups for a flat monthly price, with no cap on orders or revenue
skip_if: your store is on Shopify Advanced or Plus and runs only the occasional gift offer, since the price follows your Shopify plan and starts at $49.99 there; your promotions rely on discount codes and you do not want to check how each one combines with the gift; or you expect one ProfitKoala app to cover bundles, upsells and gifts, since they are sold as separate subscriptions
honest_knock:
The price follows your Shopify plan, not how much you use the app. A store on Shopify Advanced pays $49.99 a month for the same feature list a Basic store gets for $9.99, even if it runs one gift offer a quarter. The fee does not move by itself: the help centre says that if you upgrade your Shopify plan you have 14 days to upgrade in the app as well to keep your offers active. Downgrades are pro-rated; cancellations are not.

The gift mechanics have a few traps that the help centre documents itself. The gift product must carry a normal price above zero, because the app gives it away with a 100% discount; a gift priced at zero and published to the storefront can be bought without any of the offer's conditions. A gift can also flip from free to full price at checkout when the customer adds another discount code, unless that other discount is set to combine with product discounts. And a minimum-spend rule reads the price before discounts: with a $100 threshold, a $150 product with a 50% code still earns the gift at $75. The vendor's workaround is to use compare-at prices instead of discount codes.

There is a ceiling on offers, set by Shopify rather than by the plan. Shopify allows 25 automatic discounts per store, and the app packs about ten offers into each, which the help centre puts at roughly 90 to 250 offers. Disabling one Koala discount in Shopify's own discount screen can switch off several offers at once.

The critical reviews are few but specific. A US merchant wrote in March 2025, after six days, that the gift was not applied to orders correctly and that they had to refund customers. An Australian merchant disliked the long generated discount code the gift shows at checkout (February 2025). A US merchant who paid $599 a year for another ProfitKoala app objected in November 2025 to needing a separate subscription for BOGO offers, and a merchant in Ecuador noted in April 2025 that the app had been free and now costs money. The vendor's replies to all of them are the same template asking for an email. We installed it on a Shopify development store on 17 November 2026, built a free gift offer and saw the gift added to the cart in the theme preview, but the points above come from the help centre and the reviews.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/upsell-koala-gift and in our own test that day; earlier: read 2026-10-03 on apps.shopify.com/upsell-koala-gift and in the vendor's billing articles at koala-gift.crisp.help) Priced on the store's Shopify plan, not on use: the four plans carry the names of Shopify's own plans and the listing gives each the same feature list. Basic is $9.99 a month or $95.88 a year, Shopify $29.99 or $287.88, Advanced $49.99 or $479.88, and Shopify Plus $99.99 or $959.88. The listing says the yearly price saves 20%; a help article dated July 2025 says up to 50%, and the listing is the page you are billed from. Every plan has a 14-day free trial and, according to the listing, is free for development stores (our own test of 17 November 2026, below, found no free plan in the app). The help centre says there are no usage limits: unlimited orders and revenue at an unchanged price. Owners of several stores can ask support for special pricing. All charges are in USD, billed through Shopify every 30 days. Developer ProfitKoala, with an address in Vilnius, Lithuania; the listing gives a launch date of 9 October 2024 and shows 383 reviews, six of them at three stars or lower. Read again on 17 November 2026: the listing is titled Koala Upsell Free Gift & BOGO, still shows the four plans and their monthly and yearly amounts unchanged, repeats “Free for development stores” on every plan card and carries 396 reviews at 5.0 (383 on our first reading). In our own test the same day on a Shopify development store (the app calls itself Koala Upsells & Gifts in the admin) the app opened on a plan screen with only Basic Monthly and Basic Annual, the price following the store's Shopify plan, and no free plan to pick. Basic Monthly showed $19.99 struck through next to $9.99 a month, with a “Save up to 50%” badge and a 14 day free trial; Basic Annual showed $19.99 struck through next to $7.99 a month billed yearly, which is the listing's $95.88 a year, with a “Save up to 60%” badge. The struck through $19.99 is not on the listing. Shopify's approval screen for Basic Monthly read $9.99 every 30 days after a 14 day trial ending 1 December, with a $10.00 discount line and the words “You will not be billed for this test charge”; it also showed an Add payment method row, which we left empty, and Approve worked without a card. So on a development store “free for development stores” meant approving a Shopify test charge that is not billed, not a free tier inside the app.

compare_with.name: Koala Bundles
compare_with.why: Koala Bundles comes from the same developer and is the closest comparison in our own dossiers, and the listing says the two work together. They are priced on different things. Koala Bundles, read on 30 September 2026, is metered on the bundle revenue its offers bring in: $12.99 a month up to $1,000, $19.99 up to $5,000 and $59.99 with no ceiling. Koala Gifts, read on 3 October 2026, ignores revenue and charges by the store's Shopify plan: $9.99 on Basic, $29.99 on Shopify, $49.99 on Advanced and $99.99 on Plus. A small store on Shopify's Basic plan pays less for gifts than for bundles; a large store on Advanced pays $49.99 for gifts whatever they sell, which is cheaper than Unlimited bundles. Pick Koala Bundles for quantity breaks and multi-product bundles, Koala Gifts for gift-with-purchase, BOGO and buy-X-get-Y offers.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Koala Upsells & Gifts (listed as Koala Upsell Free Gift & BOGO) on a Shopify development store: the install through the install form, the plan wall (no free plan), the Basic Monthly test charge (approved without a card, billed 0 dollars), one free gift offer (Demo Shirt for Demo Mug) that stood in the cart as Demo Shirt $19.00 $0.00 FREE GIFT in an unsaved theme preview about 3 minutes and 9 steps after the install, the contradiction on the offer screen (Not visible, activation needed and Great job - your offer is live!), and the uninstall with a required reason. The gift picker, upsells, the Advanced and Plus plans and the real checkout were not tested. Nothing was paid. Install: the App Store listing is apps.shopify.com/upsell-koala-gift, titled Koala Upsell Free Gift & BOGO, by ProfitKoala, with From $9.99/month. Free trial available. and a rating of 5.0 from 396 reviews; the address apps.shopify.com/koala-gifts does not exist. In the Shopify admin the app is called Koala Upsells & Gifts. The app was installed through the install form with the target set to the same tab, in our own tab, at 21:38. The screen Install app said that the app needs access to View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data (Products, orders, discounts, Online Store); Install was clicked. There was no separate account or password: the app opened at once on Choose your plan. Plan wall: there is no free plan and nothing could be built before a plan was chosen. The plan was activated at 21:39 after the Shopify approval screen (see Checkout); the dashboard then said Plan activated successfully!, with Theme status 0/3 app blocks added to theme and a Setup guide at 0 / 4 steps completed. Core action, a free gift added automatically: Create a Gift Offer, then Select gift offer exposure with four options, of which Add a gift to customer's cart automatically was chosen, then New gift offer with the default name Buy One Product to get a Free Gift!. The trigger was Specific Product, Demo Mug ($9.50), and the reward was Demo Shirt ($19.00) at Free. Save gave Offer created successfully!. Visibility: right after saving, the same screen showed the status Not visible, the warning Koala Upsells & Gifts app needs activation in theme settings with Your offers aren't available on your product page, and at the same time a card saying Great job - your offer is live!. These contradict each other: the offer is only visible once the app embed is switched on in the theme. In the theme editor (preview with the app embeds) the embed Koala Gifts was switched on and NOT saved. In the unsaved preview, adding Demo Mug to the cart gave a cart with Demo Shirt $19.00 $0.00 FREE GIFT and Demo Mug $9.50. The editor was left with Leave page, so nothing was saved. No gift widget was seen on the product page itself, only in the cart. From the install at 21:38 to the free gift in the cart at 21:41 took about 3 minutes and about 9 steps (choose and approve the plan, choose the offer type, trigger, gift, save, switch on the embed, open the product, add to cart). The checkout of the store was not opened. Plans in the app (Choose your plan, with the line The price for your plan will be based on your Shopify plan): Basic Monthly, $19.99 struck through and $9.99 a month, Start 14-day free trial, with the badge Save up to 50%; Basic Annual, $19.99 struck through and $7.99 a month, Billed yearly, with the badges Save up to 60% and Priority support. Both say You won't be charged before your trial ends. Cancel anytime. The features listed are pop-up upsells on add to cart click, product add-ons and gift banners, gifts added to the cart automatically, rules by customer location and historical purchases, block designs, unlimited gifted products and upsell revenue, and live chat. The Advanced and Plus prices were not seen because the development store is on Basic. Checkout: Start 14-day free trial on Basic Monthly opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription with the notice You will not be billed for this test charge., Basic Monthly, $19,99 struck through and $9,99 USD every 30 days, a label $10,00 off all charges, You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., Subtotal $19,99 plus any applicable taxes, Discount $10,00 off, Total $9,99 Due 1 Dec, and a row Add payment method that did not have to be filled in. Approve worked without a card and was clicked: a test charge was approved, no card was entered and no payment method was added, and nothing was billed. The Basic Annual screen was not opened. Cancelling: the route in the app was not looked for. In Shopify, Settings, Apps, the menu next to the app has Uninstall; its dialog says You'll no longer be able to use the app, that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason for uninstalling is required (Testing multiple apps was chosen). The app was uninstalled at 21:44 (You've successfully uninstalled Koala Upsells & Gifts) and the subscription lapses with it. Differences from the review: the listing and the dossier say the app is free for development stores, but the app asked for a plan and a test charge before anything could be built. The strikethrough $19.99 on both plans is not in the dossier, and the annual plan is shown as $7.99 a month billed yearly, which makes $95.88 a year. The price fields are not changed here. Not tested: the gift picker (Give customers a choice of products), gift banners, upsells, the Koala Bundles tab, Kopa AI, the Advanced and Plus plans, the real checkout, analytics and live chat. Clean up: the embed was not saved. The offer and the plan went with the uninstall. Our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app does not open without a plan, although the dossier says it is free for development stores. After saving, the offer screen showed Not visible, a warning that the app needs activation in the theme settings and Great job - your offer is live! at the same time. The gift only showed in the cart, not as a widget on the product page. Uninstalling needs a reason to be chosen.
